definitions.explanation: A wound caused by a pointed object piercing the skin. Used in medical, news, and crime contexts.

examples.english: There is a puncture wound on the arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The victim's body had multiple stab wounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{釘|くぎ}→釘：03881_kugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んで→踏む：01197_fumu⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{化膿|かのう}→化膿：15315_kanou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}した→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I disinfected the puncture wound from stepping on a nail right away so it wouldn't get infected.

notes:
USAGE: {刺|さ}し{傷|きず} refers to wounds made by sharp, pointed objects — knives, nails, thorns, etc. It appears frequently in news reports about crimes and in medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刺|さ}し{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to sustain a stab wound
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{刺|さ}し{傷|きず}: deep puncture wound
- {刺|さ}し{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手当|てあ}て⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to treat a stab wound

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刺|さ}し{傷|きず}: puncture/stab wound (from a pointed object)
- ⟦{切|き}り{傷|きず}→切り傷：07340_kirikizu⟧: cut, laceration (from a blade or edge)
- ⟦{擦|す}り{傷|きず}→擦り傷：08197_surikizu⟧: scrape, abrasion (from friction)
